source: due2-native: an Agreement whose parties are string literals (external review R07, #117)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: the value of a party function is a Party (IM 2.3, 2.6), and odrl22-shape.ttl requires an IRI or a blank node there. Read as a name, "Bob" would match no assignee a request names, so the permission would never apply definitely. The same holds for odrl:target and odrl:output, whose values are Assets (IM 2.2).

expected_rejection.why: ex:read's odrl:assigner and odrl:assignee are the literals "Alice" and "Bob", and a party is a resource (IM 2.3, 2.6; decisions/0034). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
